title: Presidents Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1997

sections.shortTitle: Presidents Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXII OF 1997
ACT XXXII OF 1997
PRESIDENT'S
SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to
amend the President's
Salary, Allowances
and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
20th September,
1997]
No.F.22(96)/97-Legis., dated
20-9-1997.----The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received
the assent of the President on the 16th September, 1997, is hereby published
for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--This Act may be called the President's Salary, Allowances
and Privileges (Second Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
